div.head: V As 2
div.ab: ⁊ se þe bespirige yrfe innan oþres land: aspirige hit ut se þæt lond age, gif he mæge; gif he ne mæge, stande þæt spor for þone foraþ, gif he ðærinne hwæne teo.
Be ðon ðe yrfe bespyrige. Se ðe bespirige yrfe in on oþres land: aspyrige hit ut se ðe þæt land age, gif he mæge; gif he ne mæge, stande þæt spór for þone foraþ, gif hwone ðærinne teo.

Et qui inuestigabit (si inuestigetur) pecus in alterius terram: educat terre dominus uestigium illud extra terram suam, si possit; si non possit, stet ipsum uestigium pro superiuramento, si aliquem compellet ibi.
[Be ðon ðe yrfe bespyrige.] ⁊ se þe bespirige yrfe innan oþres land, aspirige hit ut se [þe] þæt lond age, gif he mæge. Gif he ne mæge, stande þæt spor for þone foraþ, gif he ðærinne hwæne teo.

(Von dem, der Vieh aufspürt. Ld) Und [wenn] einer die Spur [seines verlorenen] Viehs in jemandes Landgut hinein verfolgt, so führe der Besitzer dieses Guts die Spur hinaus, wenn er kann; wenn er nicht kann, so gelte, wenn [Kläg]er drinnen [im Gute] jemanden beschuldigt, die Spur statt des Voreides [des Klägers].

(Of him who tracks cattle. Ld) And [if] anyone follows the track [of his lost] cattle into someone's estate, let the owner of this estate lead the track out, if he can; if he cannot, then, if [the claimant] accuses anyone inside [the estate], let the track count in place of the [claimant's] fore-oath.

If any one traces cattle to another man’s estate, he who owns the estate shall, if he can, follow the trail, until it passes beyond his boundary. If he cannot do so, the trail shall serve for the oath of accusation, if he [the plaintiff] charges anyone on the estate.

And he who tracks cattle into the land of another—he who owns the land is to follow the trail out [of his land], if he can; if he cannot, the trail is to serve instead of the preliminary oath, if he [the loser] accuses anyone on that estate.

note.label: echoes
note.quote: Æthelstan, echoed by Edmund, earlier declared that the tracks of stolen cattle leading onto a man's land and no further will 'serve instead of the fore-oath'
